The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the music mirrors the staccato rhythm of traffic and the syncopated pulse of the subway, while the lyrical narratives weave stories of ambition, struggle, and resilience that resonate with the concrete jungle's inhabitants. This auditory layer deepens the viewer's immersion, transforming the gallery space into a dynamic soundscape that captures the raw, unfiltered essence of metropolitan existence.
